name: send_message
description: Send a message to the player during the current invocation. Use this tool to communicate narration, describe scenes and events, portray NPC dialogue, and present the outcomes of actions. Messages are delivered to the player in the order they are created. You may call this tool multiple times during an invocation to communicate as events unfold. This tool only communicates information; it does not modify the game world or character state.

text.description: The exact player-facing message to deliver. Write naturally and consistently with the current scene, characters, and narrative style.
